Note::normalize_ellipsis¶

Back to Note API Reference

Signature¶

Note Note::normalize_ellipsis() const

Convert The Ellipsis Character To Three ASCII Dots¶

normalize_ellipsis() returns a new Note, same shape as the input, with every horizontal ellipsis character (…, U+2026) replaced by three ASCII periods .... Use it to normalise text from typeset sources before a tokenizer or a display that expects plain ASCII, or so that collapse_punct can then thin the run.

Only the ellipsis character is affected; runs of literal periods are left as they are. normalize_ellipsis is shape-preserving, cell-independent, and returns a fresh Note.

Example 1: A Batch¶

const auto n = pluss::make_note(
    {std::string("wait") + "\xE2\x80\xA6" + " more", "plain"}).normalize_ellipsis();
std::cout << n << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[2], dim=1, numel=2, encoding=utf8)
["wait... more", "plain"]

See Also¶

  • Note::normalize_quotes / Note::normalize_dashes: the sibling punctuation normalisers.

  • Note::collapse_punct: reduce the resulting ... to a single ..
